core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abdelaziz is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Servant of the Mighty”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abdelaziz represents the Arabic compound عبد العزيز (ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz), “servant of al-ʿAzīz,” where al-ʿAzīz means mighty or powerful and is also a divine name in Islamic tradition. This is a compound name, not a single lexical item.

faq.a: Abdelaziz represents Arabic عبد العزيز, meaning servant of al-ʿAzīz (“the Mighty”).

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdelaziz?
faq.a: The name is Arabic and is a compound of عبد and العزيز.
Yes. The underlying compound is عبد العزيز (ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz).

faq.q: What is the root of Abdelaziz?
faq.a: عبد is related to ع ب د, while العزيز is related to ع ز ز; the name combines two elements.
Abdelaziz is a traditional Muslim name because it contains a compound invoking al-ʿAzīz, a divine name in Islamic tradition.
This record does not establish Abdelaziz as an explicitly named Qur'anic person; the compound's religious meaning is distinct from personal-name attestation in the text.

faq.q: What does Abdelaziz mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, عبدالعزیز means the servant of al-ʿAzīz, understood as the Mighty/Powerful.
The supplied “ab-de-la-ziz” is an approximate pronunciation; local pronunciations vary.

faq.q: Is Abdelaziz a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: The record classifies Abdelaziz as masculine, consistent with traditional usage; regional frequency data is not supplied.
